title: Move deals through your pipeline automatically
blurb: Create or move an opportunity when something happens, so your board stays up to date.

steps.title: Start a new workflow
steps.body: Click **Create Workflow** and start from scratch. At the top, rename it to something you will recognise later, like "Booked moves to Booked stage".

steps.title: Choose the event
steps.body: Click **Add New Trigger** and pick the moment that should move the deal, like **Customer Booked Appointment** or **Form Submitted**.

steps.title: Move the opportunity
steps.body: Add **Create/Update Opportunity**. Choose the pipeline and the stage it should land in. If the contact has no opportunity yet, one is created.

steps.title: Or react to a stage change
steps.body: You can also go the other way: use the **Pipeline Stage Changed** trigger to send a quote follow-up or a thank you when you drag a deal into a stage.

steps.title: Save, test and publish
steps.body: Click **Save**. Run **Test Workflow** on your own contact, then switch **Draft** to **Publish** and save again.
steps.tip: Nothing is sent until the workflow is published.
